# Alfi Pizza

Alfi Pizza is a New Haven-style pizza restaurant in South Africa, with two locations.

## Alfi Pizza Birdhaven (Johannesburg)
74 St Andrew Street, Birdhaven, Johannesburg, 2192
Hours: Monday–Sunday, 12:00–21:00
Order: https://order.nowish.co.za/merchants/alfi-pizza-birdhaven

## Alfi Pizza Sea Point (Cape Town)
158 Main Road, Sea Point, Cape Town, 8005
Hours: Sunday–Thursday, 12:00–21:00; Friday–Saturday, 12:00–22:00
Order: https://order.nowish.co.za/merchants/alfi-pizza-seapoint

Website: https://www.alfipizza.co.za
